reason: launch bounded meta ad from ugc video

_notes.mode: Call business_meta_ad_launch with mode='preflight' first (read-only), then mode='launch'.
_notes.activate: Launch activates by default when the operator asked to launch. Set activate=false or status='PAUSED' only when you intentionally want a staged paused campaign.
_notes.budget: Leave daily_budget_usd null to let the backend derive a bounded daily pace and end time from the remaining Meta channel credits after setup. Explicit values are still capped by TAKYON_META_MAX_DAILY_BUDGET_USD (default 50), must meet the live minimum (default 5 USD/day), and cannot exceed the reserved total cap.
_notes.ad_account_id: Blank = use META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID. Pass a sandbox account id here for a zero-risk live test.
_notes.page_id: Blank = use META_PAGE_ID. Required for the video creative.
_notes.image_url: Blank = use the uploaded video's auto thumbnail; set a public image URL if it is not ready.
